articulation.label: rain
articulation.alt: rain: /r/ → /eɪ/ → /n/. Tongue, lips, contact and airflow positions.
notes: /r/: Bunch the tongue; leave space at the ridge.
/e/: Start with the tongue mid-front.
/ɪ/: Raise the front tongue; narrow the jaw gap.
/n/: Tip at the ridge; air goes through the nose.
articulation.note: Keep each vowel glide inside one syllable.

articulation.label: train
articulation.alt: train: /t/ → /r/ → /eɪ/ → /n/. Tongue, lips, contact and airflow positions.
notes: /t/: Tongue tip touches the ridge, then releases.
/r/: Bunch the tongue; leave space at the ridge.
/e/: Start with the tongue mid-front.
/ɪ/: Raise the front tongue; narrow the jaw gap.
/n/: Tip at the ridge; air goes through the nose.
articulation.note: Keep each vowel glide inside one syllable.

articulation.label: day
articulation.alt: day: /d/ → /eɪ/. Tongue, lips, contact and airflow positions.
notes: /d/: Tip touches the ridge; add voice and release.
/e/: Start with the tongue mid-front.
/ɪ/: Raise the front tongue; narrow the jaw gap.
articulation.note: Keep each vowel glide inside one syllable.

articulation.label: play
articulation.alt: play: /p/ → /l/ → /eɪ/. Tongue, lips, contact and airflow positions.
notes: /p/: Close the lips, then release the air.
/l/: Tip at the ridge; air passes round the sides.
/e/: Start with the tongue mid-front.
/ɪ/: Raise the front tongue; narrow the jaw gap.
articulation.note: Keep each vowel glide inside one syllable.
